personal.name: Sixun Dong
personal.title: Multimodal Learning, VLM, LLM Agent
bio: I am an independent researcher working on multimodal AI systems. My research evolved from visual-temporal perception (CVPR Oral'22, CVPR'23) through generative modeling (3DV'24, NeurIPS'25) to my current focus on efficient multimodal inference and agentic reasoning (ICLR'26, ICASSP'26, ECCV'26), exploring system-algorithm co-design for next-generation multimodal intelligence. I completed my Master's at ShanghaiTech University under Professor Shenghua Gao.

research.description: Currently, my research focuses on multimodal AI systems, spanning multimodal understanding, generative modeling, and agentic systems. My work evolved from visual-temporal understanding (CVPR Oral'22, CVPR'23) to generative modeling (3DV'24, NeurIPS'25), efficient multimodal inference (ICLR'26), and agentic systems with reasoning and tool use (WACV'25, ICASSP'26, ECCV'26), with a current focus on system-algorithm co-design for efficient multimodal modeling and agentic reasoning.
stats: 10 top-tier venues (CVPR, NeurIPS, ICLR, ECCV, COLM, IJCAI, AAAI, WACV, ICASSP, 3DV)

2022.title: TransRAC: Encoding Multi-scale Temporal Correlation with Transformers for Repetitive Action Counting
2022.tldr: Introduces the RepCount dataset and pioneers the use of regression density maps alongside a Transformer-based architecture to encode multi-scale temporal correlations, significantly improving repetitive action counting.

2023.title: Weakly Supervised Video Representation Learning with Unaligned Text for Sequential Videos
2023.tldr: Proposes a weakly supervised video representation learning approach that utilizes unaligned text for sequential videos, significantly reducing the reliance on fine-grained video-text alignment annotations.

2024.title: MLLM-Tool: A Multimodal Large Language Model For Tool Agent Learning
2024.tldr: Introduces the MLLM-Tool framework and contributes a specialized dataset to empower Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with the ability to understand, learn, and invoke external tools.

2024.title: RoomDesigner: Encoding Anchor-latents for Style-consistent and Shape-compatible Indoor Scene Generation
2024.tldr: Presents RoomDesigner, which encodes "anchor-latents" to guide the generation of 3D indoor scenes that are both highly style-consistent and shape-compatible.

2025.title: MMTok: Multimodal Coverage Maximization for Efficient Inference of VLMs
2025.tldr: Proposes MMTok to efficiently select informative vision tokens via a multimodal coverage maximization strategy, significantly accelerating VLM inference while maintaining model performance.

2025.title: LiveMCP-101: Stress Testing and Diagnosing MCP-enabled Agents on Challenging Queries
2025.tldr: Constructs a stress-testing benchmark specifically designed to evaluate and diagnose the stability and limitations of MCP-enabled agents when handling complex, challenging queries.

2025.title: Complex Logical Instruction Generation
2025.tldr: Introduces an automated data generation framework and evaluation benchmark for complex logical instructions to assess and enhance the multi-step reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

2025.title: Teaching Time Series to See and Speak: Forecasting with Aligned Visual and Textual Perspectives
2025.tldr: Proposes TimesCLIP, innovatively aligning time series data with visual and textual multi-modal perspectives to effectively enhance both short-term and long-term forecasting performance.

2025.title: TimesFrame: Multi-Variable Time Series is a Video of Numerical Data
Agentic Feature Augmentation: Unifying Selection and Generation with Teaming, Planning, and Memories
2025.tldr: Builds an LLM-driven agentic framework that unifies feature selection and generation through collaborative teaming, task planning, and memory mechanisms.

2025.title: Sculpting Features from Noise: Reward-Guided Hierarchical Diffusion for Task-Optimal Feature Transformation
2025.tldr: Proposes a reward-guided hierarchical diffusion model that "sculpts" data representations from noise to generate optimal feature transformations for specific downstream tasks.

2025.title: MECT: From Multimodal Knowledge Acquisition To Contrastive Embedding Construction For Generative Feature Transformation
LLM-ML Teaming: Integrated Symbolic Decoding and Gradient Search for Valid and Stable Generative Feature Transformation
2025.tldr: Introduces an LLM-ML teaming framework that integrates symbolic decoding with gradient search to achieve highly stable and valid generative feature transformations.

2025.title: Efficient Post-Training Refinement of Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
2025.tldr: Proposes an efficient post-training refinement strategy specifically designed to optimize and unlock the deep logical reasoning capabilities of LLMs within their latent representation space.

2025.title: Brownian Bridge Augmented Surrogate Simulation and Injection Planning for Geological CO2 Storage
2025.tldr: Combines Brownian Bridge-augmented surrogate models to provide highly efficient simulation and injection planning for optimizing geological CO2 storage strategies.

2025.title: Unsupervised feature transformation via in-context generation, generator-critic llm agents, and duet-play teaming
2025.tldr: Presents a fully unsupervised feature transformation framework utilizing generator-critic LLM agents and in-context generation via duet-play teaming to automatically extract high-quality features.

2025.title: Bridging the domain gap in equation distillation with reinforcement feedback
2025.tldr: Introduces a reinforcement learning feedback mechanism to effectively bridge and calibrate the domain gap in equation distillation tasks.

2025.title: A Survey on Data-Centric AI: Tabular Learning from Reinforcement Learning and Generative AI Perspective
2025.tldr: A systematic review focusing on how state-of-the-art reinforcement learning and generative AI models can be leveraged to improve the quality and efficiency of tabular data learning.

2025.title: Towards Data-Centric AI: A Comprehensive Survey of Traditional, Reinforcement, and Generative Approaches for Tabular Data Transformation
2025.tldr: A comprehensive survey mapping the evolution of Data-Centric AI in tabular data transformation, covering traditional statistical methods, reinforcement learning, and generative AI approaches.

2026.title: Better Call CineCrew: Consistent Ultra-Long Narrative-to-Film Generation
2026.tldr: A multi-agent 'film crew' that orchestrates off-the-shelf video generators for long-form narrative-to-film generation, coordinated through FilmDSL—a film-oriented domain-specific language that makes cinematic constraints (shots, camera, assets, character personas) explicit. Generation and critic agents plan, synthesize, and repair clips to keep both visual identity and character behavior consistent across the film. Joint work with UMass & MIT.

2026.title: Rethinking Model Efficiency: Multi-Agent Inference with Large Models
2026.tldr: Analyzes VLM end-to-end latency and reveals that output token length dominates inference cost. While large models with short outputs outperform small models with long generations, reasoning remains essential for complex tasks. We bridge this by proposing a multi-agent framework where a small model computes the reasoning tokens and transfers them to a large model, achieving large-model accuracy with minimal latency.

2026.title: To Think or Not To Think, That is The Question for Large Reasoning Models in Theory of Mind Tasks
2026.tldr: Investigates the capabilities of Large Reasoning Models (like OpenAI o1/o3) on Theory of Mind tasks, revealing that continuous reasoning does not always guarantee better socially-aware outcomes.

2026.title: Towards Robust Dysarthric Speech Recognition: LLM-Agent Post-ASR Correction Beyond WER
2026.tldr: Proposes an LLM-agent-based post-ASR correction framework for dysarthric speech recognition that focuses on semantic accuracy rather than just minimizing Word Error Rate (WER).
